currentState: Agent Desktop Companion is a public GitHub repository currently still hosted at https://github.com/ZhangZhengruiNUS/claude-sprout; the remote has not been renamed yet.
The app is a Windows-first Tauri v2 + React + TypeScript + Rust local-first AI Agent desktop companion.
The primary surface is Glint, a transparent, frameless, always-on-top pet window. The full session panel is secondary and opens from Glint or the tray.
The first integration is Claude Code session state through local hook/statusline writers; the product direction is broader agent session reminders, local data, skills, and API configuration.
implemented: React/Vite frontend and Tauri v2 Rust desktop shell with tray, hidden-on-start main panel, and primary transparent pet window.
Claude Code PowerShell and Node hook/statusline writers that persist local session snapshots and bounded event metadata without prompt/output capture by default.
Local session model for idle, running, tool_running, waiting_permission, waiting_input, done, error, stale, probably_closed, and closed, including heartbeat-derived stale/probably_closed states.
Message and Board pet assistant modes: Message intervenes for permission/completion/failure; Board keeps a persistent multi-session stack with pagination.
Settings for language, theme, pet appearance, pet size, always-on-top, lock position, DND, Message/Board behavior, transcript-preview opt-in, and local storage cleanup.
Codex/Hatch-compatible 8x9 pet import workflow with scan, validate, import, preview, apply, remove-from-app, and delete-files flows.
Preview-bound local storage cleanup for safe terminal sessions and old events, while imported pets remain explicitly managed.
Windows release tooling for standalone exe, NSIS installer, optional MSI, release doctor, release tool pre-cache, controlled session smoke, and handoff update automation.

Agent Desktop Companion identity migration: package/crate/Tauri product identity, app identifier, event protocol, docs, hooks, storage defaults, localStorage key, and release paths use agent-desktop-companion naming.
Glint is the built-in standard pet and visual identity: generated head-only winged technology sprite atlas, app icon, tray icon, favicon, and project PNG assets are checked in.

Legacy compatibility is retained: CLAUDE_SPROUT_HOME, %USERPROFILE%\.claude-sprout, retired built-in Claude Sprout pet ids, old localStorage keys, and claude-sprout hook wrapper files continue to be recognized.
Repository continuity files: AGENTS.md, docs/next-session.md, docs/devlog.md, docs/handoff-state.json, and scripts/update-handoff.mjs.
knownBlockers: Direct NSIS/WiX tool downloads through the normal Tauri/PowerShell TLS stack can still fail on this machine because SChannel may fail to create TLS client credentials. Use npm run release:precache-tools to populate the local Tauri tool cache through Node HTTPS before installer builds.

MSI bundling is optional and still depends on WiX being present in src-tauri\target\.tauri\WixTools314 or installed on PATH. Do not block a normal release on MSI unless a specific distribution requirement needs it.
The GitHub remote is intentionally not renamed by this code migration. Rename the repository manually when ready and update local remotes after GitHub redirects are confirmed.

importantDecisions: Agent Desktop Companion is the product/repository-facing name; Glint is the built-in pet and visual mascot, not the repository name.
Do not make the product a browser-style dashboard. The Glint pet window is the first-class UI.
Do not auto-approve Claude Code permission prompts.
Keep prompts/outputs out of stored state by default. Conversation preview remains explicit local opt-in and stores only one bounded snippet.
PowerShell hook writer is the default for Windows; Node hook writer remains a fallback.

Default local data root is %USERPROFILE%\.agent-desktop-companion. AGENT_DESKTOP_COMPANION_HOME overrides it; CLAUDE_SPROUT_HOME and %USERPROFILE%\.claude-sprout remain legacy compatibility paths and are not moved or deleted automatically.
Canonical hook scripts use agent-desktop-companion-* names; claude-sprout-* wrappers remain temporarily for compatibility.
Codex-compatible imported pets use the Codex/Hatch Pet 8-column by 9-row atlas contract; unused cells remain transparent and should not be stepped through during playback.

Imported pet deletion must stay explicit and local: removing from the app hides only the installed manifest, while deleting files removes only the validated imported pet directory under the active app-data pets root.

User-facing pet assistant modes are Message and Board: Message is low-frequency rich-context intervention for permission/completion/failure, Board is the persistent multi-session stack, and waiting_input remains a weak non-interrupting state.
Official Windows release artifacts are the standalone release exe and NSIS installer; MSI remains an optional maintainer build, not a required release artifact.
